newsitem.title: USA: Domenici hopes resolve US budget differences today.
newsitem.headline: Domenici hopes resolve US budget differences today.

text.p: Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici said he was "hopeful" differences among budget negotiators from the White House and Congress would be resolved Tuesday.
"We're very hopeful that it will be ... the last meeting necessary to complete our work," Domenici said.

Negotiators are trying to write out priority agreements that would be acceptable to the White House and Republicans "so we can buttress the budget resolution with an agreement saying we intend to carry out these priority kinds of things," the New Mexico Republican told reporters.
Domenici said he hoped the budget resolution would go before the Senate Budget Committee for consideration Thursday.
Tax cut issues will be addressed in a separate letter from the congressional leadership, he said.
"My hope is that this be a bipartisan budget," Domenici said.
